Light has nothing to do with this effect, though it's a common misconception. It uses the depth buffer, where pixels that are near the camera are black and those that are far away are white, with shades of grey as you interpolate between the two extremes. Dark areas, like the Tomb of the Giants, are just as bright as anywhere else; more so, in some cases, since wide-open spaces provide better contrast to the player than cramped corridors.
